confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026 / mission25: unresolved paused source is not authoritative empty
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Cold paused query has undefined data, isPending=true, isLoading=false and no error. deriveDataState correctly returns initial/isRefreshBlocked=true, but endpoint receives neither pending nor blocked status, only isLoading=false. Its false configured flag selects No region on record although no response established absence. Global Paused offline notice does not correct that contradictory local claim.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Synthetic source specification: supply that cold-paused query without cached data. Executed pure helper output confirms initial/hasData=false/blocked=true/endpointIsLoading=false; source branch then selects EmptyState. No browser or network offline simulation ran.
confirmedIssues.expected: Keep unresolved/paused endpoint content distinct from a successful empty result, with appropriate paused/loading explanation and safe recovery.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Pass the existing source initial/blocked distinction to the mounted endpoint adapter; preserve reference and retained fields. Add covering tests only in a separately claimed fix.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Empty-state Refresh calls the same bare mutate callback as the header but never receives isPending. Shared EmptyState action has no loading/disabled props in its action contract. Header alone disables, while empty CTA remains clickable and can initiate another POST during an outstanding refresh, against the five/minute limit.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Synthetic source-derived specification: resolve an empty envelope, start refresh and leave it pending, then activate empty CTA again. Source permits a second callback. No POST or page interaction was executed.
confirmedIssues.expected: All entry points for one region-refresh mutation show pending and reject repeated activation.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Claim page and endpoint prop/adapter ownership together; guard the common callback and compose existing pending-aware Button feedback without weakening shared EmptyState or inventing another mutation.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-040: user-facing action failure feedback
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Caller supplies neither withToast nor onCopyError. Clipboard rejection is caught, copied resets false, only console.error executes and the success-only live region stays empty. Users receive no failure or manual-copy guidance.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Synthetic source specification: render a nonempty URL and make clipboard.writeText reject, then activate Copy. Source catch has no user-feedback path in this composition. No clipboard/browser operation ran.
confirmedIssues.expected: Localized visible/assistive failure feedback while retaining full selectable URL; success remains announced once.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Use existing CopyButton withToast or onCopyError capability at this caller; do not change the shared clipboard controller unnecessarily.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-040 / MDC-043: mobile44 target source contract
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Icon-only copy keeps default sm/h-9 and no mobile min-h/min-w44 override, unlike the corrected page Refresh. Required mobile target sizing/exception is absent from this composition.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Source-level sizing specification below768px: CopyButton uses sm/h-9 classes, not the page header's44px minimum. Effective browser dimensions, CSS overrides and spacing exception remain NOTRUN.
confirmedIssues.expected: Below md a documented44x44 reachable target; retain compact desktop density.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Use existing CopyButton className sizing at the endpoint caller and later validate native geometry. Shared defaults should not be changed globally.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: protocol facts must not imply unsupported secure transport
confirmedIssues.mechanism: URL parser accepts http and page completeness checks only non-null scheme/host. Brief pairs raw HTTP with unconditional Secure transport and source status ok, despite HTTP not being secure.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Executed local production-helper evaluation of synthetic http://fleet-api.prd.eu.vn.cloud.tesla.com yields scheme=http/regionKey=eu/configured=true/sourceStatus=ok. Brief's unconditional localized context is source-proven. No URL visited; backend reachability of such data is UNKNOWN.
confirmedIssues.expected: Neutral transport wording or explicitly validated HTTPS-specific explanation; retain raw unsupported protocol instead of silently changing it.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Narrow domain protocol validation/presentation fix with existing unknown/partial semantics; no regional configuration write.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026: regional identity inference must stay source-bounded
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Dotted na/eu/cn regex recognizes any hostname or even malformed raw string, not the documented Fleet API datacenter structure. An unrelated .eu. host is therefore assigned the official Europe zone and the inferred label takes precedence over raw region.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Executed parseEndpoint('https://service.eu.example.invalid') returns host=service.eu.example.invalid/scheme=https/regionKey=eu; page completeness is ok. This is a local synthetic semantic misclassification, not a real Tesla endpoint, request, exploit or production incident.
confirmedIssues.expected: Unknown host retains raw fields and neutral/unknown inference rather than a false Fleet API zone.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Narrow existing helper inference to documented supported endpoint structure while preserving genuinely supported hosts and raw unknown/malformed values. Server contract/alternate-host support remains an integration prerequisite.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-002 / workspace scope: account-wide snapshot must not imply selected-vehicle filtering
confirmedIssues.mechanism: /tesla-region is not a disabled path or prefix; shared scope returns vehicle=true even though region GET/key never uses selected vehicle. Range correctly returns false.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Executed production getWorkspaceRouteScope('/tesla-region') returns {range:false,vehicle:true}. No shell/browser selector operated.
confirmedIssues.expected: Account-wide alias disables the header vehicle picker rather than advertising a scope it does not consume.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Parent integration owner adds exact /tesla-region to existing disabled-path authority, with separately claimed route-scope coverage; no page-local picker workaround.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-044 / frontend SI cutover i18n canonical keys
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Hook asks for toast.user.region.success/error; canonical toast has no user node and neither direct dotted key exists. Existing translated regionRefreshed/regionFailed keys are present at toast root instead. Fallback strings mask the wrong keys.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Executed canonical JSON traversal returns false for both consumed keys and TOAST_USER_NODE_PRESENT=false; source translation helper falls back to English. This proves key mismatch, not runtime locale rendering. Actual mutation toasts were not triggered.
confirmedIssues.expected: Hook reuses authoritative existing translated toast.regionRefreshed/toast.regionFailed keys or a separately authorized canonical integration; no scattered catalogue patch.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Narrow hook key correction reusing existing catalogue entries; catalog/generated files remain untouched by this audit.

confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-046: mutations remain live-only in historical read-only mode
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Region refresh POST omits requiresLiveMode; client defaults false and operational guard returns before reading read-only mode. Page disables only pending. The offline unsafe-path list also does not cover this account-refresh path. Thus an online /tesla-region?as_of=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z can invoke the refresh despite the shared historical read-only badge.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Source-derived historical-mode specification: visit that synthetic URL online and activate Refresh. Source call path reaches the request transport without live-mode refusal. No visit, mutation or outbound request executed; no offline-queue behavior claimed.
confirmedIssues.expected: Explicit live-only request interlock and informative read-only action state, while GET retries/copy/reference remain usable.
confirmedIssues.fixNeed: Claim hook guard and page action-state composition separately from this audit. Reuse existing operational-mode APIs; do not invent queues or alter global configuration.
